workflow.stage_a: Compare candidates on chronological holdout and grouped district CV; metrics are held-out only.
workflow.stage_b: Refit selected candidate on every eligible observation for scenario prediction.

selection_rule: Lowest MAE on the latest-two-year chronological holdout among candidate models; predictions clipped at zero for both evaluation and inference.

category_thresholds_kg_ha.definition: Empirical 25th and 75th percentiles of all eligible historical yield observations.

district_grouped_cv: 5-fold GroupKFold by district; estimates transfer to unseen districts and is reported separately, not used to select the known-district scenario model.

excluded_features.year: Not requested by the scenario UI and would imply future-year forecasting; this app predicts a user-entered rainfall scenario.
excluded_features.area_ha: Used only for optional yield-to-production conversion.
excluded_features.yield_calculated_kg_ha: Derived from actual production/area and excluded to prevent target leakage.

nonnegative_prediction_policy: Predictions are clipped to zero; model validation metrics apply the same clipping.
validation_limitations: Only 26 observations in two holdout years; known districts overlap training. Grouped district CV tests unseen-district transfer separately. Small sample means metrics are uncertain and negative R² is retained as observed.
